title: MeteoAlarm CAP feed for Portugal

provenance.by: sources/meteoalarm-pt/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: MeteoAlarm: re-users must name the national service (IPMA), keep the time of issue, link www.meteoalarm.org and publish MeteoAlarm's disclaimer. latest.json carries all four.

about: MeteoAlarm's feed for Portugal as a compact table, one line per CAP message (English text where given, the national event name beside it). The national service is IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera); sent_utc is each message's time of issue. A dated record, not a warning service.

attribution.national_service: IPMA, Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera
attribution.disclaimer: Time delays between this website and the www.meteoalarm.org website are possible. For the most up-to-date awareness information as published by the participating National Meteorological and Hydrological Services, please refer to www.meteoalarm.org.
